soldier: The soldier has the head reddish brown, the frontal surface slightly deeper, mandibles blackish brown; the labrum yellow in ground colour with a reddish brown triangular spot in the middle; pronotum paler than the head, abdomen and legs pale yellowish brown. Head shaped like a long cylinder, the two sides parallel, the posterior margin straight. In profile the dorsal angle of the frons hardly raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, both the dorsal margin of the head and the ventral margin of the postmentum nearly straight; the frontal surface bears a shallow V-shaped depression, the Y-shaped suture visible. Compound eyes large and distinct, ocelli small. Labrum flat and square, mandibles rather slender and straight, the length of the left mandible about half that of the head capsule. Antennae with 13–14 segments. The postmentum about seven times as long as the width at its waist, its widest part in the anterior third, with several transverse striae behind the anterior margin, the waist region behind the midpoint, the sides parallel and gradually diverging backwards. Pronotum slightly wider than the head, the median longitudinal line visible; the anterior margin straight or very slightly concave, the two sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin projecting outwards, a small notch in the middle of both the anterior and posterior margins.
